Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished children's picture book illustration atlas for "Big Trucks, Little Bridge". It is a production game texture: a tall portrait canvas divided into EXACTLY 2 COLUMNS and 4 ROWS, eight equally sized rectangular panels, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Every panel must remain exactly in its own grid cell with no overlap; no panel outlines, no gutters, no titles, no text, no letters, no numbers. Each panel has a complete illustrated background. Soft hand-painted children's storybook gouache and watercolor with readable dark contours, colorful and beautiful, appealing to young children. Keep the same characters, clothes, objects and colour palette consistent across all eight panels. Gentle expressions and warm lighting, imaginative detailed environments, not clipart. Do not use copyrighted characters. Scenes in order:
Panel 1: A curious child in a yellow hard hat and red boots stands beside a stream; friendly orange digger and blue dump truck nearby.
Panel 2: Same child draws a simple bridge plan on paper; two banks of stream and safe clear work area.
Panel 3: Orange digger scoops earth at one stream bank; child watches well outside work zone.
Panel 4: Blue dump truck tips gravel into a tidy pile beside stream, same child at safe distance.
Panel 5: Small yellow crane carefully places wooden beam across stream; child behind low safety fence.
Panel 6: Nearly complete wooden bridge, workers attach rails, smooth boards, no dangerous child work.
Panel 7: Adult builder inspects completed bridge while two children wait, friendly trucks behind.
Panel 8: Two friends and little wagon cross finished bridge with rails; orange digger blue truck yellow crane celebrate quietly.
The grid is critical: 2 equal-width columns, 4 equal-height rows. Fill the canvas edge-to-edge with the 8 separate panels. Portrait aspect ratio approximately 2:3.

Use case: illustration-story. Make a children's game atlas of SIX CLOSED picture books on a true transparent background, precisely 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows. Each book entirely inside its equal cell with generous clear padding, front cover facing us, no scenery or cast shadows outside the books. Every book has a different attractive painted cover with legible exact title. Top left: sky blue dinosaur book titled "Hello, Dinosaurs!" with friendly T. rex and Triceratops. Top middle: orange construction cover titled "Big Trucks, Little Bridge" with small excavator and wooden bridge. Top right: deep navy space book titled "Rocket to the Moon" with red white rocket and moon. Bottom left: mint fairy garden book titled "The Fairy Garden Surprise" with a tiny brown-skinned fairy and pink flowers. Bottom middle: lavender book titled "The Princess and the Lost Star" with a brown-skinned princess with a dark braid holding a glowing star paper lantern. Bottom right: aqua mermaid book titled "The Mermaid and the Rainbow Shell" with a copper-skinned mermaid with curly dark hair and rainbow shell. Rich storybook watercolor and gouache, clear charming silhouettes, professional print-quality illustration, not generic icons. No other text, no background glow. All 6 portrait-shaped books same physical dimensions, evenly sized. Landscape canvas 3:2.
